macro.note: Decision at 8:15 AM ET with the press conference at 8:45 AM ET, in Berlin. All 65 economists in the Reuters poll expect a 25 basis point increase to 2.50%, the second of the cycle, and then a pause. Brief this as a HIKE - framing the ECB as easing is wrong by direction.

macro.note: The single most important scheduled release of the month. Governor Waller said explicitly on September 3 that his policy decision 'will be heavily influenced by what we learn about August inflation' - this is that reading. University of Michigan preliminary sentiment also lands September 11. The August prior could not be verified primary this run and is not published.
